newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil- more low sulphur to U.S.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil- more low sulphur to U.S.

text.p: Low sulphur straight-run fuel oil has made a big impact in clearing a recent overhang.
Traders said 60,000 tonnes were sold on Thursday at around $126 fob NWE for the U.S. The same sellers also did a further 30,000 tonnes at $135 cif NWE on October 5-10 dates.

Activity has picked up because sellers were coming to terms with buyers reluctance to pay numbers that reflected crude's recent strength. "It's cheap compared with crude, but it's not easy to shift," said one trader. The glut of high sulphur Russian M-100 has eased, but prices remain under pressure. E-4 was seeing formula +$2-3, its scarcity protecting prices.
